* Accepted standalone POR-subblock measurement fixture.
.lib "__MODEL_LIB__" tt

.include "__DUT_NETLIST__"
.option scale=1e-6 reltol=1e-4 abstol=1e-14
.temp -40
VDD vdd 0 1.8
VENA ena 0 PWL(0 0 100u 0 100.01u 1.8 3m 1.8 3.00001m 0 4m 0 4.00001m 1.8 6m 1.8)
XDUT vdd out ena 0 rc_osc
CLOAD out 0 50f

.control
set noaskquit
set wr_singlescale
set wr_vecnames
set numdgt=12
save v(ena) v(out) i(VDD)
tran 500n 6m 0 500n
wrdata wave.tsv v(ena) v(out) i(VDD)
quit
.endc
.end
